'''Gastol''' was the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Brenta]] in the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]],<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Gastol had three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="CW" /><ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal system]], except [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], were introduced in the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Brentaal star system in grid square L-9.<ref name="EA" />
